name: See3CAM_27CUG

sources.title: See3CAM_27CUG - 2MP OV2312 Global Shutter RGB-IR USB Camera (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor (OmniVision OV2312), shutter, chroma (colour and NIR), optical format, pixel size, active area, FOV with e-con's lens, focus, holder, output formats, frame rate, interface, size, board weight

note: An RGB-IR global-shutter USB camera (one OV2312 sensor giving a colour and an IR stream, both UYVY). FOV 88.4 (D) x 74.65 (H) x 62.76 (V) degrees "with the lens provided by e-con". The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rate "Streams 2MP @ 36 fps"; the stream size of the "2MP" mode is not stated, so no stream is entered (the active area is 1600 x 1300). mass_g is the stated board weight with lens, 20 g (16 g without). Power is not stated (null). size_mm is null: the page gives only "30 x 30" (l x b). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion.
